metadata.technology_specification: Benchtop flow cytometer with multi-laser optical system and fluidics
metadata.technology_reasoning: Benchtop flow cytometers with multi-laser optics represent the most common industry-standard instrument for cell analysis due to their flexibility, resolution, and widespread use in clinical and research labs as of 2024.

components.reasoning: Fundamental to directing cell suspensions through a focused stream, universally present and typically a separate subsystem.
Core to excitation and fluorescence/scatter detection; includes lasers and photodetectors as distinct modules.
Critical for separating emission wavelengths, usually procured as assemblies integrated with detection optics.
Enables controlled introduction of samples into the fluidics stream; common as a separate unit, though integrated in some designs.
Hosts the processing electronics, data acquisition, and control systems; essential and separately manufactured.
Provides control and data visualization, typically a separate component though designs vary.
Collects used fluids post-analysis, often a separate module or system component.
Structural frame housing internal components, standard in all instruments to support and protect hardware.

Fluidics System.name: Polyethylene
Fluidics System.reasoning: Used widely for tubing and fluid transport due to chemical resistance and flexibility; very common in fluidics systems.

Fluidics System.name: Polypropylene
Fluidics System.reasoning: Commonly used for connectors and reservoirs because of chemical resistance and moldability; frequently used in fluidic components.

Fluidics System.name: Polytetrafluoroethylene
Fluidics System.reasoning: Used for seals and tubing due to excellent chemical inertness and temperature resistance; standard in fluidic systems.

Fluidics System.name: Glass
Fluidics System.reasoning: Used for flow cells and observation windows in the system; alternatives exist but glass is standard for optical clarity and chemical resistance.

Fluidics System.name: Stainless steel
Fluidics System.reasoning: Often used for fluidic valves and fittings for strength, corrosion resistance; a standard metal for fluidics components.

Optical Detection System (Lasers and det.name: Gallium arsenide
Optical Detection System (Lasers and det.reasoning: Key semiconductor material for laser diodes emitting in relevant wavelength ranges; widely used in optical lasers.

Optical Detection System (Lasers and det.name: Indium gallium arsenide
Optical Detection System (Lasers and det.reasoning: Used in photodetectors for sensitivity in near-infrared; standard detector material though alternatives exist.

Optical Detection System (Lasers and det.name: Silicon
Optical Detection System (Lasers and det.reasoning: Fundamental semiconductor for photodiodes and electronics; common detection material though complementary materials used for some wavelengths.

Optical Detection System (Lasers and det.name: Glass
Optical Detection System (Lasers and det.reasoning: Used in lenses and protective windows; common optical material but some plastic optics possible.

Optical Detection System (Lasers and det.name: Aluminum
Optical Detection System (Lasers and det.reasoning: Used in heat sinks and some components for lightweight thermal management; substitution possible with other metals.

Optical Filters and Dichroic Mirrors.name: Glass
Optical Filters and Dichroic Mirrors.reasoning: Primary material for optical filters and mirrors substrate due to optical clarity and stability; industry standard.

Optical Filters and Dichroic Mirrors.name: Borosilicate glass
Optical Filters and Dichroic Mirrors.reasoning: Used as filter substrate for higher thermal and chemical resistance; common in high-performance optics.

Optical Filters and Dichroic Mirrors.name: Aluminum oxide
Optical Filters and Dichroic Mirrors.reasoning: Used as coating materials for optical filters and mirrors to provide reflection and anti-reflective properties; standard but alternatives exist.

Optical Filters and Dichroic Mirrors.name: Silver
Optical Filters and Dichroic Mirrors.reasoning: Common reflective coating for high reflectivity dichroic mirrors; industry standard though some mirrors use aluminum coatings.

Sample Injection Module.name: Polypropylene
Sample Injection Module.reasoning: Common material for syringes and sample holders due to chemical resistance and biocompatibility; typical for injection components.

Sample Injection Module.name: Stainless steel
Sample Injection Module.reasoning: Used for needles and mechanical parts for strength, durability, and corrosion resistance; standard choice.

Sample Injection Module.name: Polyethylene
Sample Injection Module.reasoning: Used for tubing and fittings in sample introduction; lower cost alternative with good chemical resistance.

Sample Injection Module.name: Glass
Sample Injection Module.reasoning: Sometimes used for flow cells or components needing optical clarity; alternatives available so moderate confidence.

Electronics Console/Main Control Board.name: Silicon
Electronics Console/Main Control Board.reasoning: Primary semiconductor material for integrated circuits and microprocessors; absolutely essential.

Electronics Console/Main Control Board.name: Copper
Electronics Console/Main Control Board.reasoning: Widely used conductor for circuit board traces and internal wiring; industry standard.

Electronics Console/Main Control Board.name: Gold
Electronics Console/Main Control Board.reasoning: Used for wire bonding and connectors to ensure corrosion resistance and conductivity; common but alternatives exist.

Electronics Console/Main Control Board.name: Epoxy resins
Electronics Console/Main Control Board.reasoning: Used as PCB substrate and encapsulant due to good insulation and mechanical properties; industry standard.

User Interface Module (Touchscreen/displ.name: Glass
User Interface Module (Touchscreen/displ.reasoning: Primary substrate for touchscreen and display panels due to optical transparency and mechanical strength; standard.

User Interface Module (Touchscreen/displ.name: Indium
User Interface Module (Touchscreen/displ.reasoning: Key component of indium tin oxide transparent conductors used in touchscreens; industry standard.

User Interface Module (Touchscreen/displ.name: Acrylic
User Interface Module (Touchscreen/displ.reasoning: Used for touchscreen covers and bezels due to good optical clarity and ease of molding; common but alternatives exist.

User Interface Module (Touchscreen/displ.name: Silver
User Interface Module (Touchscreen/displ.reasoning: Used in some conductive inks and components in displays; alternatives such as copper exist, so moderate confidence.

Waste Collection System.name: Polypropylene
Waste Collection System.reasoning: Widely used for waste fluid containers due to chemical resistance and impact durability; standard material.

Waste Collection System.name: Polyethylene
Waste Collection System.reasoning: Also common for waste collection containers and tubing; chemical resistant and cost-effective.

Waste Collection System.name: Stainless steel
Waste Collection System.reasoning: Used in structural or valve components requiring strength and corrosion resistance; alternatives possible so moderate confidence.

Chassis/Enclosure.name: Aluminum
Chassis/Enclosure.reasoning: Common material for instrument chassis due to light weight, strength, and corrosion resistance; industry standard.

Chassis/Enclosure.name: Steel Ingots
Chassis/Enclosure.reasoning: Used to make steel structural parts of chassis; strong and cost-effective, often used alongside aluminum.

Chassis/Enclosure.name: Acrylic
Chassis/Enclosure.reasoning: Used for panels and cosmetic enclosure parts due to good optical properties and ease of fabrication; alternatives exist so moderate confidence.
